ideas.description: Exploit: the pre-registered BN-bias follow-up, which adds margin at no time cost. On the E061 tip (2/2/3 net, 2x20+3x24+3x28+2.5x32 px, head scale 2x, ls 0.4, BN-bias lr multiplier 16x; official 0.7560, dev 0.7586 @ 5.24 s), halve the BN-bias lr multiplier from 16x to 8x. Change nothing else: Muon lr and momentum, head lr, SGD-group wd and momentum, schedule, Lookahead, resolutions, freezing and the whitening-bias window all stay fixed. If the multiplier lives in the GPU schedule tensor, no recapture is needed; otherwise recapture all graphs in build. Log the absolute BN-bias:head lr ratio before and after (the references sit at about 1:10-1:13). Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12 and compare against E061's dev mean of 0.7586. Contingency: if dev rises by 0.15 pp or more, try 4x next. If dev falls by 0.15 pp or more, 16x brackets the optimum and the BN-bias axis is closed.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.5%, about 5.24 s). Dev mean moves -0.25 to +0.25 pp from 0.7586, with a weak prior of +0.0 to +0.15 pp: each earlier halving gave +0.27-0.29 pp, but the response must flatten near the references' ratio. Keep if the dev gain is at least 0.1 pp and official is at least 0.7535. The added margin would be spent on the group-2 width cut or the 24 px epoch drop.

ideas.description: Exploit: width-based work removal in group 2, the cheapest remaining structural lever now that the depth floors are reached. First microbenchmark ms/step per phase on the E061 recipe (graphed, Muon included) for group 2 at width 384 vs 320, in both of its convs. Widening to 448 cost +13.6% per trial, so a large saving is expected. If 320 saves at least 4% per trial, narrow group 2 from 384 to 320 on the E061 tip: adjust the group-3 entry conv (320→576), the group-2 BN params and the Muon batched-NS shape groups. Hold epochs, resolutions, schedule, ls, head scale, BN-bias multiplier, freezing and the bias window fixed. Recapture all graphs in build. Check that eval returns finite [B,100] logits for B in {1, 7, 513, 1024}. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12. If the microbenchmark saves under 3%, log it and do not run.
ideas.expected: Time falls 6-11% (about 4.65-4.95 s). The 16x16→8x8 group-2 convs and the 320→576 entry lose about 17-31% of their MACs, plus smaller NS Grams. Dev mean falls 0.1-0.4 pp, centred near -0.25 pp, i.e. at or better than 0.67 pp/s (the 32 px tail rate). Keep if dev is at least 0.7558 and official at least 0.753. If dev lands in 0.754-0.7558, bank the cut to stack with the next margin source, such as BN-bias 8x. This is removed work, so it should carry over to the PCIe judge.

ideas.description: Exploit: remove an early low-res epoch, since E036 and E063 show the early phase is saturated. On the E061 tip, drop one 24 px epoch, giving 2x20+2x24+3x28+2.5x32 (32 fewer steps). Fix the LR warmup length and the Lookahead alpha ramp in absolute steps at their E061 values, so the decay portion absorbs the shortfall; this reuses the anchoring code path from E063. The whitening-bias window (20 px phase only) and the conv1 freeze at 32 px are unchanged. Same 4 graphs, nothing new to capture. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12 and compare against E061's dev mean of 0.7586.
ideas.expected: Time falls 0.3-0.42 s (-6 to -8%, to about 4.85 s). On the 2/2/3 net, a 20 px epoch measured +0.34 s in E063, and a 24 px epoch costs somewhat more. Dev mean changes by -0.25 to +0.05 pp, centred near -0.1 pp. Keep if dev is at least 0.7558 and official at least 0.753. A dev loss under 0.1 pp supports H1.11, makes the 2x20+2x24 ladder the new base, and makes H1.11.2 (spend the saving on +0.5 epoch at 32 px) the follow-up. A loss of 0.3 pp or more means the 24 px rung does feature learning that the 28 px phase cannot absorb.

ideas.description: Exploit, separating the two knobs that E053 confounded. On the E061 tip, keep the head output scale at 2x and halve the head-weight lr (in the SGD head group), changing nothing else. Under Agarwala et al., the effective head lr scales as lr·β², so the 2x scale also quadrupled the effective head step. Halving the lr tests whether part of E053's +0.44 pp came from temperature and part was a too-large head step. The lr is a per-group value in the schedule tensor, so recapture only if it is a graph constant. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12. Contingency: if dev falls by 0.15 pp or more, run 2x head lr next. If |Δ| < 0.1 pp, the head lr is not a live knob at this scale; close H1.10.2.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.5%). Dev mean moves -0.25 to +0.25 pp, with no strong prior on sign (weak lean +0.05 pp, since the BN-bias halvings also gained). Keep if the dev gain is at least 0.1 pp and official is at least 0.7535.

ideas.description: Calibration against the winner's curse, with no recipe change and nothing kept. Run the E061 tip code unchanged on fresh held-out seeds 13-22 (10 trials) outside the official command, using the existing trial-seed plumbing. Log per-seed accuracy and time. Seeds 13-22 then stay out of all selection, and are used only for the final pre-submission check of whichever tip exists at the end. Dev seeds 3-12 have now driven about 6 keep decisions (E053, E054, E055, E056, E058, E061), so the dev mean of the current tip is likely biased upward.
ideas.expected: Metrics unchanged (5.24 s). Held-out mean 0.7566-0.7581, i.e. 0.05-0.2 pp below the dev mean of 0.7586, with per-seed std 0.2-0.3 pp rather than E061's 0.13. Decision rule: if the held-out mean is below 0.7558, raise the dev keep bar for time cuts by the measured bias and prioritize margin sources (BN-bias 8x, head lr) before the group-2 width or 24 px cuts. If it is at least 0.7575, dev is unbiased and the current keep bar stands.

ideas.description: Explore whether orthogonalization quality is still below saturation, a margin source the tree has not tested since E035 and E052 showed steep losses below the current budget. On the E061 tip, add a third fixed-coefficient quintic Newton-Schulz step after AOL preconditioning (AOL + 3), keeping lr 0.205, momentum 0.655 and the per-step renorm. Change nothing else. Recapture all graphs in build. Log Muon ms/step per phase. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12.
ideas.expected: Time rises by about 0.08-0.15 s (+1.5-3%), from one more batched NS step over about 330 steps on the 2/2/3 matrices. Dev mean rises 0.0 to +0.25 pp, centred near +0.1 pp. To beat the 32 px tail exchange rate (0.67 pp/s), it needs at least about 0.1 pp per +0.15 s; if so, it becomes a margin source to pay for the group-2 width cut. A gain under 0.1 pp means AOL + 2 already saturates quality, and H1.12 is closed.

ideas.description: Explore input regularization, given E060's 21 pp train-test gap (variance-limited, not under-fit). On the E061 tip, add GPU-side Cutout with an 8 px square (at 32 px coordinates, applied before downscaling) to training images only during the 24 px and 28 px phases. The 20 px phase and the 2.5-epoch 32 px tail stay clean, so the final fit matches the test distribution. Draw the masks per epoch with the trial-seeded generator inside the existing un-graphed per-epoch augmentation, so no graph changes. Change nothing else. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12.
ideas.expected: Time +0.3-1% (one masked fill per epoch on GPU). Dev mean moves -0.3 to +0.25 pp, with no strong prior: the gap argues for a gain, while airbench Appendix B finds Cutout hurts at 10 epochs or fewer. Keep if the dev gain is at least 0.15 pp and official is at least 0.7535. If |Δ| < 0.1 pp, input regularization is not the binding axis, and H1.3.2 and H1.3.5 should be deprioritized.

ideas.description: Exploit with a small work-removal cut, gated on a code check. First inspect the E061 BN modules. If BN weights are trainable or eps differs from the references, freeze BN weight at 1 (requires_grad False, removed from the SGD group) with eps 1e-12, matching airbench94_muon and Hiverge, in every block. Change nothing else. Recapture all graphs in build. If the port already matches, close H1.7.13 without a run. Otherwise run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12.
ideas.expected: Time falls 0.3-1% (about -0.02 to -0.05 s): no BN-weight gradient reductions and one less foreach update. Dev mean within ±0.1 pp of 0.7586, or slightly up, since both Muon references drop the BN scale under per-step weight renorm. Keep if time is at least 0.3% lower, dev is at least 0.7558 and official at least 0.753. A dev loss of 0.15 pp or more means the BN scale carries useful per-channel gain here.

structured_output.summary:
The queue was empty (every idea was done or dropped), so I added 8 ideas built on the E061 tip (dev 0.7586 @ 5.24 s). Expected margin is about +0.28 pp over the dev level of about 0.7558 needed for P(official ≥ 0.753) ≈ 0.9. The split is 5 exploit and 3 explore.

**Exploit, adding margin at no time cost:**
- **BN-bias 8x (H1.10.1, priority 5):** the pre-registered next step after two +0.28 pp halvings.
- **Head lr 0.5x at fixed scale 2x (H1.10.2):** separates the effective-lr part of E053's head-scale gain.

**Exploit, removing time:**
- **Group-2 width 384→320 (H2.7.2):** behind a microbenchmark gate. It is the largest remaining structural lever, since widening to 448 cost +13.6%. Expected about -6 to -11% time.
- **Drop one 24 px epoch with anchors fixed (H1.11.1):** expected about -0.35 s, given that the early phase is saturated (E036, E063).
- **Freeze BN weight (H1.7.13):** a small cut, gated on a code check first.

**Calibration:**
- **Held-out seeds 13-22 on E061 (H4.3.2):** de-biases the dev mean after about 6 selections on the same dev seeds and sets the keep bar for the time cuts.

**Explore:**
- **AOL + 3 NS steps (H1.12.1):** tests whether orthogonalization quality is still below saturation.
- **Cutout in the 24/28 px phases only (H1.3.8):** tests input regularization, given the 21 pp train-test gap from E060.

No queued ideas needed dropping. If the BN-bias 8x run adds margin, stack it with the group-2 width cut and the 24 px drop next.
